name: Katia Sycara
title: Edward Fredkin Research Professor; Associate Director of Faculty
department: Robotics Institute, School of Computer Science
fitReason: Combines human–robot collaboration and multi-agent AI with current vision-language/3D spatial methods. A focused spatial grounding or robot decision-making study is a plausible research fit, without implying a current visitor opening.

physicalEvidence.summary: The March 1, 2026 pySpatial primary paper and ICLR 2026 project demonstrate an actual Unitree Go1 navigating a two-room, 50-square-meter laboratory from sparse images toward a target object. MLLM-generated Python invokes reconstruction, pose recovery and novel-view tools. Crucially, the high-level position plan is manually converted into timed velocity targets for the robot controller; this is physical plan execution, not fully autonomous end-to-end closed-loop navigation.
